ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: series of dark spots along distal-leading edge and scattered medial spots. Right lobe: dense dark pixel cluster at distal tip and along leading edge. Dark pigmentation concentrated at the central notch and peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 140 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude serrations; higher frequency of pixel-level irregularities observed at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge boundary extending from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters detected primarily in the distal third of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, vertical dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the proximal-medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged pixel topography at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating non-smooth boundary conditions.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive asymmetric distribution of dark spotting, with a higher concentration of low-intensity pixels on the right distal tip compared to the left.
